_about: Per-person residency evidence layered over the Forbes data. Every entry carries a dated evidence note and at least one source. 'departureTiming' marks a reported departure: 'pre_snapshot' = before the January 1, 2026 residency date, 'post_snapshot' = after it, 'unconfirmed' = reported intent or secondhand report only. Whether any of these changes California domicile is contested; the calculator keeps them in the default base and lets the user remove them.

Larry Ellison.evidence: Forbes lists Manalapan, Florida (checked 2026-09-17). Galle, Gamage, Saez and Shanske's July 20, 2026 report removes him as very likely a Florida resident, and Rauh et al. (2026) exclude him. Excluded from every base.

Drew Houston.evidence: Rauh et al. (2026) classify him as a non-resident. Forbes lists San Francisco, California (checked 2026-09-17).

Lynsi Snyder.evidence: Rauh et al. (2026) classify her as a non-resident. Forbes lists Franklin, Tennessee (checked 2026-09-17).

Larry Page.evidence: Fortune (2026-03-17) lists him among six billionaires who took steps to leave before January 1, 2026. Forbes lists Palo Alto, California (checked 2026-09-17).

Sergey Brin.evidence: Fortune (2026-03-17) lists him among the six; NPR (2026-08-22) reports a move to the Nevada side of Lake Tahoe. Forbes lists Los Altos, California (checked 2026-09-17).

Peter Thiel.evidence: Fortune (2026-03-17) lists him among the six. Forbes moved him off its California list on 2026-09-03.

Don Hankey.evidence: Fortune (2026-03-17) lists him among the six. Forbes lists Las Vegas, Nevada (checked 2026-09-17).

Steven Spielberg.evidence: Fortune (2026-03-17), citing the Los Angeles Times, reports he became a New York City resident on January 1, 2026. Forbes moved him off its California list on 2026-09-03.

Travis Kalanick.evidence: Said on the record that he moved to Texas on December 18, 2025 (Fox Business, 2026-03-16). Forbes lists Austin, Texas (checked 2026-09-17).

David Sacks.evidence: Announced Craft Ventures' Austin office on 2025-12-31; Craft said he relocated to Austin in December 2025 (San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-01-02). Not on the Forbes billionaire list; Fortune reports his net worth as $250 million to $2 billion. The $2.0 billion row reproduces Rauh et al. Table 6 on the October 17, 2025 snapshot only.

Mark Zuckerberg.evidence: Rauh et al. Table 7 lists him as a post-January 1 departure; Boll, Saez and Zucman (2026) treat him as extremely likely a California resident on January 1, 2026. Forbes lists Palo Alto, California (checked 2026-09-17). A post-January 1 move does not change wealth-tax liability.

Jan Koum.evidence: Listed in Rauh et al. Table 7 as a reported departure. No primary reporting of a move found as of 2026-09-17; Forbes lists Atherton, California.

Reed Hastings.evidence: Listed in Rauh et al. Table 7 as a reported departure. No primary reporting of a move found as of 2026-09-17; Forbes lists Santa Cruz, California.

Andy Fang.evidence: Statement of intent only: the SF Standard tracker (2026-01-22) records him saying it would be irresponsible not to plan an exit, and does not list him as leaving. Forbes lists California.
